beats.say: Why is your app slow? Often, it keeps asking the database the exact same question.

beats.text: Every request hits the slow database.
beats.say: Every request goes to the database, which is slow, and easy to overload.

beats.text: A cache is fast memory in front of the database.
beats.say: A cache is fast memory placed in front of the database.

beats.text: Cache miss: fetch from the database, then store it.
beats.say: First request: a cache miss. We fetch the answer from the database, then store it in the cache.

beats.text: Cache hit: instant answer. The database is never touched.
beats.say: Next time, it's a cache hit. The answer comes back instantly, and the database is never touched.

beats.text: Memory is limited: evict the oldest, expire with a TTL.
beats.say: But memory is limited. When the cache fills up, it evicts the least recently used item. And every entry has a time to live, after which it expires.
